name: Minot AFB
description: Home of the 5th Bomb Wing and 91st Missile Wing. Minot AFB operates B-52 bombers and Minuteman III ICBMs, providing strategic deterrence in the northern tier.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (Bldg 240)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with Visitor Control Center.

gates.name: Visitor Control Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0630-1630; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required.

gates.name: North Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays

resources.name: Dakota Inn Dining Facility
resources.description: Primary DFAC serving the 5th Bomb Wing and 91st Missile Wing with full meal service and grab-and-go options.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830; Sat-Sun: Bfast 0630-0830, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830

resources.name: Minot AFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency full-service grocery with CLICK2GO curbside pickup.
resources.address: 360 Missile Ave, Bldg 246, Minot AFB, ND 58705

resources.name: Minot Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Minot Main Exchange with food court, barber, beauty shop, optical, GNC, and shoppette.

resources.name: Northern Tier Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: McAdoo Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with state-of-the-art equipment, indoor track, rock wall, racquetball, family workout room, saunas, and 24/7 access for registered CAC holders.
resources.hours: Staffed: Mon-Fri 0600-2100, Sat-Sun/Holidays 0800-1800; 24/7 for registered users

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for unaccompanied personnel.

resources.name: Sakakawea Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.
resources.hours: Guest services desk daily 0600-2200; after-hours check-in available

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 5th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Rough Rider Bowling Center
resources.description: 22-lane bowling center with pro shop, multi-sport simulator, and party packages.

resources.name: Minot AFB Golf Course
resources.description: On-base golf course with pro shop.

resources.name: 5th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access. REAL ID required.

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Sakakawea Inn (701-723-6161) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (701-723-7284) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 5 FSS, M&FRC, and official Minot sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
